question: What is the warranty coverage for GCM Netting Solutions products and their installation service?
answer:
At GCM Netting Solutions, we stand firmly behind the quality and durability of our products and services provided across Chennai. We offer a comprehensive warranty ranging typically from 3 to 5 years on our safety nets, depending on the specific product and application. This warranty primarily covers manufacturing defects in the material, ensuring the nets are free from flaws in workmanship and materials such as our high-grade HDPE material which is meticulously UV stabilized for maximum longevity and resistance to sun degradation.

Our warranty also extends to the professional installation service performed by our skilled technicians for all safety nets Chennai projects. We guarantee that the nets are installed correctly and securely, adhering to the highest safety standards. Should you encounter any issues related to material defects or faulty installation within the warranty period, GCM Netting Solutions will promptly assess the situation and provide necessary repairs or replacements. Please note that the warranty generally does not cover damage resulting from misuse, accidents, or external forces not attributable to manufacturing or installation faults. For full details on your specific product's warranty or to raise a concern, please don't hesitate to call us at +91 99123 99224. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
